# netbox_config_context (Resource)

Manages a NetBox config context (`/api/extras/config-contexts/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_config_context" "example" {
  name = "example"
  data = jsonencode({})
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) Data as a JSON document (`jsonencode({...})`).
- `name` (String) Name.
